quoted.text:
拼贴动画 B-roll Skill 正式开源🔥
评论区可见

👹整个工作流程如下:
1、Codex skill 安装与首次环境自检（缺什么教你配什么）
2、一句口播文稿 → 压成一个视觉隐喻：核心意思、关键物件、底色、组装顺序
3、隐喻确认后才生成彩色拼贴静帧 + contact sheet（Gate 2 再确认一次）
4、静帧通过才烧钱：Gemini Omni Flash 首尾帧组装动画
5、空色场开场，纸片逐件滑入卡位，stop-motion 质感
6、自动去音轨，交付 9:16 竖版 5 秒成片，直接垫口播
7、三重 QA：逐秒抽帧、首帧空场验证、尾帧与确认静帧对照

🧐Tips: 三道确认闸门是故意设的——改文字免费，重生图便宜，重跑视频才是真花钱。批量丢 10 句文稿进去，只放行你看顺眼的

黑白半调人物 + 彩色卡纸点缀，底色跟着语意换：焦橙讲消耗、深紫讲沉淀、青绿讲协作

备注: 这个目前只跑 Codex（静帧生成依赖内置 image_gen），Claude Code 和其他还在适配
MIT 开源，脚本全自带，clone 下来就能用

name: 弎水
text:
拿pro订阅送的API额度，试了下刚出的gpt-image-2.6，一口气跑完两套微信动态表情包——《内阁打工人》和《精神稳定的藏狐》

加上前期测试，全流程一共也就4刀出头的赠金，四舍五入等于白嫖，分享下摸索出来的4步极简工作流：

1. 先抽1号锚点图锁人设：调generations接口先跑每套的第1张，参数开 output_format="gif" + size="320x320" + background="transparent"，底层会按3×3母版直出9帧透明动图。确认人设和印章/标牌比例OK后，抽出第0帧存成 anchor.png

2. 喂锚点图并发跑齐整套：剩下15张直接把 anchor.png 喂给 edits 接口并发跑，只改动作描述和配字。古风方印尽量固定用2×2四字词，现代标牌用粗体短词，两套32张下来零错字

3. 微信深色模式去白沫避坑：prompt里千万别惯性加 white sticker border（白色贴纸描边）或者标牌连接杆，不然帽翅和耳朵缝隙里全是抠不干净的白沫，切微信深色背景直接没法看。强制写死 strictly NO white sticker border, NO white outline，让印章和标牌直接悬空就OK

4. 脚本一键合规打包：最后用python按9帧联合包围盒居中缩放到240×240，保留前景原始RGB做GIF89a透明量化（不向白底预乘），顺手裁好cover和icon就能直接丢微信表情后台了

name: Zara
text:
Some heroes never stop walking. ❤️

Created with GPT Image 2.6 + Seedance 2.5 on @wavespeed_ai

Prompt:

AUDIO RULE: Natural sound only. No music, no score, no voiceover, no dialogue. Ambient New York city sound and foley only.

CHARACTER LOCK: <<<image_1>>> , exactly as shown in the character sheet in every shot: same face, hair, build, wardrobe, posture and proportions. She carries one folded broadsheet newspaper, the same one in every shot. She never stops, never breaks stride, never looks at the camera, and keeps an unhurried, composed expression. Location: <<<image_2>>> , late-autumn daylight, consistent weather and color grade across all shots.

SHOT 1 (0:00–0:03)
Camera: Low, locked-off medium shot at table height on a busy sidewalk. Slight tracking left to right as she enters frame.
Action: <<<image_1>>>  walks past a sidewalk café where a diner's wobbling table sloshes his coffee. Without slowing, she flicks the folded newspaper low and slides it under the short table leg. The table settles and the coffee goes still. The diner looks down, then up, confused and pleased. She is already out of frame.
Sound: Footsteps on pavement, the rattle of a wobbling table, the cup settling, traffic hum, distant chatter.

HARD CUT

SHOT 2 (0:03–0:06)
Camera: Handheld tracking shot from the front, medium close-up, backing away as she walks toward us.
Action: A tourist juggling bags knocks his takeaway cup off the rim of a trash bin. As it falls, <<<image_1>>> , still mid-stride, taps the newspaper out in one fluid motion and bats the lid back onto the cup. He catches it and stares at her back as she passes.
Sound: Quick cup tumble, the soft slap of paper on plastic, her steady footsteps, a surprised breath from the man.

HARD CUT

SHOT 3 (0:06–0:09)
Camera: Wide side-on profile tracking shot, matching her pace, with a crosswalk and yellow taxis behind her.
Action: A man on a bench is lost in his phone while a pigeon edges toward his sandwich. Without turning her head, <<<image_1>>>  snaps the newspaper once as she passes. The pigeon flaps off and the sandwich is saved. The man looks up, bewildered, with no idea who helped.
Sound: A sharp crack of newsprint, wing flutter, honking taxis, a street vendor's cart rattling.

HARD CUT

SHOT 4 (0:09–0:12)
Camera: Slow wide shot from behind, centered on her small figure as she walks away down the long avenue.
Action: <<<image_1>>>  tucks the newspaper under her arm and keeps walking at the same unhurried pace. Behind her, the people she helped each carry on with their day, lighter and smiling. She never looks back and disappears into the crowd and morning light.
Sound: Footsteps fading into the city ambience, distant traffic, a faint laugh, the soft rustle of newsprint under her arm.

AVOID: music, dialogue, text overlays, slow motion, camera looks, character design drift, changes to her outfit or the newspaper between shots.

MOTION RULE: Continuous movement in every shot. The couple never stop, freeze or hold a pose, and the camera is always moving. Every romantic moment happens while they walk, spin or run.

STYLE: Hand-painted illustrated look, matching the location reference: soft painterly brush texture, warm amber lamplight against cool lavender-gray snow haze. Same color grade in every shot.

CHARACTER LOCK: <<<image_1>>>  is a single character sheet showing two people. The TOP ROW is the woman and the BOTTOM ROW is the man. Match both exactly in every shot.
The woman (top row): messy curly dark-brown hair in a loose updo with loose strands, freckles, small gold hoop earrings. Long dark brown textured wool coat, white collared shirt, charcoal wide-leg trousers, black leather belt, black lace-up boots. She also wears a burgundy fringed wool scarf, as in the location image. She carries a paper cup of tea with the tea-bag tag hanging out.
The man (bottom row): tall, tousled wavy dark-brown hair, freckles. Long brown herringbone tweed coat, olive-green fringed scarf, cream cable-knit sweater, dark brown trousers, dark leather boots.
SCARF LOCK: His olive scarf stays on his neck and her burgundy scarf stays on hers in every shot. Scarves never move between people.
Faces, hair, outfits, heights and proportions never change between shots. They look at each other with deep affection and never look at the camera.

LOCATION: <<<image_2>>> , snowy Upper West Side at dusk. Gas-style street lamps, snow-covered trees, black iron fences, brownstones with warm lit windows and snowy stoops, a street sign reading "W 73 St / Broadway", a yellow taxi, the Empire State Building glowing in the haze. Soft snow falls throughout.

SHOT 1 (0:00-0:03)
Camera: Wide tracking shot gliding backward ahead of them down the snowy sidewalk, lamps streaking past.
Action: They walk toward us, his arm around her shoulders, her tea steaming. She leans her head against him while they walk, and he kisses the top of her head without breaking stride. Snow swirls through the lamplight and a yellow taxi slides by behind them.
Sound: Crunching, slushy footsteps, a muffled tire hiss, a soft contented sigh, gentle wind.

HARD CUT

SHOT 2 (0:03-0:06)
Camera: Medium shot, smooth handheld tracking sideways at walking pace, shallow depth of field.
Action: Still walking, he opens the front of his coat and pulls her in against his side, wrapping the coat around her shoulder. His olive scarf stays on his neck and her burgundy scarf stays on hers. She laughs, looks up at him, and catches a snowflake on her tongue. He grins and tucks a loose curl behind her ear as they keep moving.
Sound: Her bright laugh, wool rustling, quick footsteps, snow hush.

HARD CUT

SHOT 3 (0:06-0:09)
Camera: Low tracking shot at hip height, following their hands and the cup as they move, warm window lights streaming past.
Action: They swing their linked hands as they walk. She lifts the steaming cup to his lips and he sips, smiling at her. Snowflakes melt on his knuckles and her burgundy scarf fringe while the tea-bag tag sways.
Sound: Cup crinkle, a quiet sip, playful breath, soft footsteps, a car passing.

HARD CUT

SHOT 4 (0:09-0:12)
Camera: Fast but smooth circling orbit around them, snow flying through the foreground.
Action: He lifts her hand and spins her under his arm. Her coat flares and her curls swing as she twirls, laughing. She spins back into him and they keep moving in a flowing walking waltz down the sidewalk, foreheads close, eyes locked.
Sound: Coat swish, her delighted laugh, quick light footsteps in snow, a distant bell.

HARD CUT

SHOT 5 (0:12-0:15)
Camera: Sweeping crane move that begins close and rises into a wide pull-back, following them up the avenue with the Empire State Building glowing in the haze.
Action: Hand in hand, they run a few joyful steps through the falling snow, then he pulls her in and they kiss mid-stride, still moving, her scarf fringe flying. They keep walking away up the avenue, arms around each other, leaving two sets of footprints as the flakes thicken.
Sound: Quick crunching footsteps, a happy laugh, coat rustle, fading into the hush of falling snow.

AVOID: music, dialogue, text overlays, still poses, freeze frames, camera looks, face or hairstyle drift, swapping the two characters' outfits, scarves moving between people, any change to coats, scarves, earrings or boots between shots, photorealistic style.

quoted.text:
Fable5.2 ロールアウト!!
すでに全員使える状態です!!
注目すべきベンチスコア等について解説します～
Opus5.5でやった方が良いことも多々あるので公式推奨の使い分けも書きます

■スコアが上がった重要ベンチ
実案件をもとにした成果物づくり（RLI）17.9% → 41.3%  ※1

RLIベンチは実際のフリーランス案件をもとに、AIの成果物が人間の納品物と同等以上と判定された割合で、5.1の約2.3倍です。

つまり、仕事の仕様を渡して丸投げで質の高い成果物を出す割合が大幅に上がったということで、EQや視野の広さ、仕様を満たす要件の詰め方やクオリティを詰める能力が上がった可能性が高いです。

・ハードウェア設計 44.4 → 83.5%
Opus 5.5 は65.3。
公式が一段落のプロンプトから基板・筐体・ソフトまで作り、3つの電子機器を動作させた事例も出しています。AI×ハードウェア革命、く、くる…。

・実務コーディング 32.4% → 49.1%
OSSのメンテナにマージされるコードを書けるかを見るテストで、公開済みモデルでは最高。これはかなり気が効いてないと難しいので、気の利いたコードがかけるようになってる説

■ほかにも大きく伸びたベンチ（5.1 → 5.2）
・ロボット操作 27.6% → 64.9%
　GPT-6 Astra（29.8%）の2倍超
・業務フロー自動化 31.4% → 51.4%
・科学研究のエージェント作業 52.6% → 74.6%
・グラフ読み取り44.8% → 73.4%

■そこまで伸びていないベンチ
・PC操作：89.3%で、Opus 5.5とほぼ同じ
・知的業務：人間が見比べるEloでは1785で、Opus 5.5（1800）のほうがわずかに上。おーん
・AutomationBenchとChartography：5.1から大きく伸びたが、Gemini 4 Carbonとはほぼ横並びか負けです。
・AI研究開発（カーネル最適化・LLM設計）：安全上の理由で、訓練時にあえてOpus 5.5並みに抑えたと公式が明言。
・サイバー・生物：Fableでは大半のタスクが分類器でブロック、この分野をやるならMythos（審査制）が必要。

■価格と速度
- 入力トークンあたり$8/M：$10から低下
- 出力トークンあたり$40/M：$50から低下
- 20%安価
- 最大30%高速化

安くて速くなった？何が起きてる。

■Opus 5.5との使い分け
公式の推奨は「まずOpus 5.5から始め、足りなければFableへ上げる」。

□Opus 5.5がいい時
・日常のコーディングや調べもの、文章作業
・トークン単価が半分なので、量が多い作業
・セキュリティ系の作業

□Fable 5.2がいい時
・Opus 5.5をHigh/Maxにしても届かない難しい問題
・仕様が曖昧な丸投げ、何時間も走る長いエージェント作業
・多数のサブエージェントを指揮する作業
・Opusに作業させ、詰まった時だけFableに相談する「Advisor」構成も公式に案内

スコア見ても
普段使い　→　Opus5.5
丸投げ、大規模改修　→　Fable5.2
って感じはする。意外と主要スコアはOpus5.5からそれほど変わらないものも多いので。
エフォートはHighが一番コスパ良さそう

■Fable 5.5はまだ控えている？
・Azureのカタログに「claude-fable-5-5」の行が一時的に出た（10/13、数日で削除）
・Cursorが「fable-5.5」のモデルIDに対応した（10/17）
・パートナー企業にFable 5.5のチェックポイントが配られた、というリーク（TestingCatalog 10/17、11/1）
みたいなことがあったので、5.2が出て皆「！？」ってなってますね。

上場も控えていることですし、そのタイミングで最強の5.5を出す可能性はあり。

5.2はそのための繋ぎっぽさもあるけど、丸投げ系タスク、長時間タスク、大規模タスクには現時点最強と言って良いスコアなのでバンバン使っていって良さそう

Fableリセットっていう謎チケットも配布されてたので、5.5を待たずに早速私は自分のプロジェクトに使って行くことにするぜ

name: Niko
text:
卧槽 我单方面宣布，image 2.6的image to svg直接杀死比赛

这个功能刚出的时候，我测了好几个平台的接口，发现烂的没法用

然后评论区有个朋友说效果很好，我甚至一度怀疑我俩用的不是一个模型。

对话了好几轮才发现一个细节：我用的是文生SVG，直接传提示词；他用的是图生SVG。

然后我再直接拿来测试了一下，直接上生产环境下最复杂的图，果然是一比一转化，完全不会丢失细节

真尼玛牛逼啊！！！好了，这下可以让我的自建的svg项目滚犊子了！

quoted.text:
GPT Image 2.6上线，看了一圈，都在关注生成gif图的能力

toolify上今天已经看到有人找到相关的需求词上站了

我第一眼看中的是生成svg的能力，这个在一些垂直领域是痛点中的痛点

昨天兴冲冲跑去测了一圈，只能说一个字，烂！

只能处理一些基础的矢量图，高精度和信息量大的完全解决不了

而且慢的离谱，失败率也高

我有一个工程化的项目用来生成svg的，以为可以无缝平替，没想到根本没法用

我好几个垂类的网站的痛点，都是现有的ai模型没解决的

只能通过设计一些交互，通过其他的办法达成效果

估计是因为人群太少，不值得解决，不然就没我们啥事了

忽然发现，AI解决的不好的问题，就是独立开发者的机会！
